2116286212340342990.en_summary: After underperforming by 4.6 percentage points in September, the S&P 500 Equal Weight index had its best month versus the cap-weighted S&P 500 since April 2009. It was Equal Weight's 2nd best month versus cap-weighted since 1990. $RSP $SPY
2116286212340342990.zh_summary: 在 9 月跑輸 4.6 個百分點後，標普 500 等權重指數相對於市值加權標普 500 的表現是自 2009 年 4 月以來最佳月份。這是等權重指數自 1990 年以來相對於市值加權的第二佳月份。$RSP $SPY

2116284271191367832.en_summary: $AAPL just overtook $NVDA to reclaim its spot as the world's most valuable company. Quoted: $NVDA has handed $AAPL the title of world's most valuable company, again. $NVDA fell out of first by dropping 10% in October. On Oct. 6 it was $903B more valuable than Apple.
2116284271191367832.zh_summary: $AAPL 剛剛超越 $NVDA，重新奪回全球最有價值公司的位置。引用：$NVDA 再次將全球最有價值公司的頭銜交給 $AAPL。$NVDA 因 10 月下跌 10% 而失去第一名。10 月 6 日時它比蘋果更有價值 9030 億美元。

2116281849253367957.en_summary: Absolutely wild that Kalshi's non-sports revenue is on track to overtake $HOOD options revenue after barely generating anything at the start of 2025.
2116281849253367957.zh_summary: 絕對瘋狂，Kalshi 的非體育收入有望超越 $HOOD 的期權收入，而它在 2025 年初幾乎沒有產生任何收入。

2116280985612636573.en_summary: BREAKING: S&P Global revises its outlook on Meta, $META, to "negative," citing "significant uncertainty" surrounding CapEx and free operating cash flow (FOCF). The negative outlook reflects expectation that the company's leverage could exceed 1.0x and FOCF could remain negative for longer than expected. S&P is now raising concerns about AI CapEx.
2116280985612636573.zh_summary: 突發：標普全球將 Meta $META 的展望修訂為「負面」，理由是圍繞資本支出和自由營運現金流（FOCF）的「重大不確定性」。負面展望反映預期公司槓桿可能超過 1.0 倍，且 FOCF 可能比預期更長時間保持負值。標普現在對 AI 資本支出提出擔憂。
